newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat's Toro H1 1996 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Fiat's Toro H1 1996 profit up.

text.p: Italian insurer Toro Assicurazioni SpA, part of the Fiat group, said first half 1996 parent company pre-tax profit rose to 111.3 billion lire from 105.7 billion in the first six months of 1995.
Group pre-tax profit was 127.7 billion lire against 106.1 billion.
Total group premium income rose to 1.31 trillion lire from 1.29 trillion lire.
The company said in a statement it saw full year 1996 group profit in line with that of 1995, with total premium income expected to be over 30 percent up on last year.
Toro had 1995 consolidated net profit of 166.5 billion lire and total premium income of 2.64 trillion lire.
